confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several Lima-specific aggregator sources (Expatistan, Nomad Ranker citing Numbeo/Expatistan medians, Expat Arrivals, combien-coute.net) that broadly agree once converted from soles. Beer, cocktail and wine rely on mixed-venue listings and crowdsourced data that differ by up to about 2x. Wine is the weakest drink anchor: it draws on a hotel-bar listing and a rough range, and was set at about 1.5 times the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Lima's hostel and hotel tiers; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. Soles-to-USD conversions in the sources imply roughly 3.2 to 3.6 PEN per USD. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rate page for 18 November 2026; the F11.1 table itself was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city substitution was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Lima-specific aggregated price sources. Drink anchors use local beer as a reference point where direct data was thin. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for Lima's registered hostel and hotel tiers, without a search.
